scheme_name: State Government Backward Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 10)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student studying in classes 6 to 10
Applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh
Applicant must belong to the Backward Classes or Minorities community
Parents or guardians must not be income taxpayers
Parents or guardians must not own more than 10 acres of land
There should be no increase in the income of parents or guardians in the past year
benefits_summary: Scholarships of ₹200–₹300 per year for boys and ₹300–₹400 per year for girls in classes 6‑10, transferred directly to the student's bank account.
